global.description: Global GFS2 settings affecting all GFS2 operations on this node

locking_type.description: Locking mode: 1 = local (no cluster), 2 = lock module (deprecated), 3 = cluster (default; requires cman/corosync). Must match cluster configuration.

lock_dump_threshold.description: Dump lock state to syslog after this many locks (for debugging). Set to 0 to disable.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the GFS2 utility log file (e.g., where gfs2_quota outputs messages).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: 0=none, 1=error, 2=warning, 3=info, 4=debug. Higher levels increase I/O and log size.

cluster_name.description: Cluster name (e.g., 'mycluster'). Only used if not managed by a cluster manager like cman or corosync. Prefer leaving empty in cluster-managed setups.

lockspace_name.description: Explicit lockspace name. Only needed in rare standalone (non-cluster) deployments. Usually inferred from cluster name.
